{"code":"def transform(grid):
    n=5
    out=[]
    for r in range(n):
        row=[]
        for c in range(n):
            vals=[grid[r][c],grid[r][c+n],grid[r+n][c],grid[r+n][c+n]]
            # priority top-right, top-left, bottom-left, bottom-right
            row.append(vals[1] or vals[0] or vals[2] or vals[3])
